lines.name: l1
lines.text: Jacob tricked his blind father and took his brother's blessing. Now Esau wanted him dead. He ran. What would God say to a man like that?

lines.name: l2
lines.text: He lay down in the open, with a stone for his pillow.

lines.name: l3
lines.text: In a dream he saw "a ladder set up on the earth," with "the angels of God ascending and descending on it."

lines.name: l4
lines.text: The LORD stood above it and promised:

lines.name: l6
lines.text: Before Jacob did anything to make things right, God promised to stay.

lines.name: l8
lines.text: Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.

lines.name: l9
lines.text: Centuries later, Jesus used that same picture about himself, calling himself the Son of man: "ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man."

lines.name: l10
lines.text: Jacob never climbed that ladder. God came to him first.
